procedural_matters: The International Jury decided to call an hearing under RRS 62.1
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
Keith Videlo - coach vessel registration number GBR 577 - did not come to the hearing. The hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
Charlotte Videlo (GBR 221854) did not come to the hearing. The hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
Anna Cuccia, International Jury member, presented the allegation on behalf of the International Jury.
The International Jury provided photo evidence.
facts: During the starting procedure of race F5, gold fleet, the Coach boat registration number GBR 577 was about 25 m behind the RC starting vessel and about 15 m behind the racing boats.
At the moment of the incident the preparatory signal was displayed.
Coach boat registration number GBR 577 immediatelly moved away from the starting line as soon as the International Jury signalled to him to do so.
When the International Jury informed the Coach boat registration number GBR 577, about the intention to protest, he apologised for the incident.
conclusions: By being at about 25 m meters of the boats racing during the starting procedure of the Gold fleet, coach GBR 577 broke ESTR 5.1.1
By being less than 50 meters of the starting line, and RC starting vessel, during the starting procedure of the Gold fleet, coach GBR 577 broke ESTR 5.1.2
decision: Coach GBR 577 is issued a warning GBR 221854 is issued a warning that any further breach of a rule by her coach may result in a penalty to her.
